datasets.name: kpis
queryLines:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        filter(
          array(
            CASE
              WHEN bug_report THEN 'Bugs'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN pricing THEN 'Preços'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN game_balance THEN 'Balanceamento'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN toxicity THEN 'Toxicidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN community THEN 'Comunidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN visuals THEN 'Visual'
            END
          ),
          x -> x IS NOT NULL
        ) AS temas
      FROM
        reviews_enriched
      WHERE
        (
          :game = 'Todos'
          OR game = :game
        )
        AND (
          :language = 'Todos'
          OR language = :language
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.min IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) >= :periodo.min
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.max IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) <= :periodo.max
        )
    )
  WHERE
    (
      :tipo = 'Todos'
      OR array_contains(temas, :tipo)
    )
    AND (
      :sentimento = 'Todos'
      OR sentiment = :sentimento
    )
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS nota,
  COUNT(*) AS volume,
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(sentiment) = 'positive' THEN 1
        WHEN lower(sentiment) = 'negative' THEN -1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS sent_score
FROM
  f

datasets.name: trend_score
queryLines:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        filter(
          array(
            CASE
              WHEN bug_report THEN 'Bugs'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN pricing THEN 'Preços'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN game_balance THEN 'Balanceamento'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN toxicity THEN 'Toxicidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN community THEN 'Comunidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN visuals THEN 'Visual'
            END
          ),
          x -> x IS NOT NULL
        ) AS temas
      FROM
        reviews_enriched
      WHERE
        (
          :game = 'Todos'
          OR game = :game
        )
        AND (
          :language = 'Todos'
          OR language = :language
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.min IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) >= :periodo.min
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.max IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) <= :periodo.max
        )
    )
  WHERE
    (
      :tipo = 'Todos'
      OR array_contains(temas, :tipo)
    )
    AND (
      :sentimento = 'Todos'
      OR sentiment = :sentimento
    )
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(at) AS day,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(score) AS s
  FROM
    f
  GROUP BY
    DATE(at)
)
SELECT
  day,
  ROUND(
    SUM(s) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

        SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
        0
      ),
    2
  ) AS nota_7d
FROM
  daily
ORDER BY
  day

datasets.name: trend_themes
queryLines:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        filter(
          array(
            CASE
              WHEN bug_report THEN 'Bugs'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN pricing THEN 'Preços'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN game_balance THEN 'Balanceamento'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN toxicity THEN 'Toxicidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN community THEN 'Comunidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN visuals THEN 'Visual'
            END
          ),
          x -> x IS NOT NULL
        ) AS temas
      FROM
        reviews_enriched
      WHERE
        (
          :game = 'Todos'
          OR game = :game
        )
        AND (
          :language = 'Todos'
          OR language = :language
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.min IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) >= :periodo.min
        )
        AND (
          :periodo.max IS NULL
          OR DATE(at) <= :periodo.max
        )
    )
  WHERE
    (
      :tipo = 'Todos'
      OR array_contains(temas, :tipo)
    )
    AND (
      :sentimento = 'Todos'
      OR sentiment = :sentimento
    )
),
ex AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(at) AS day,
    t AS tipo_t
  FROM
    f
    LATERAL VIEW
      explode(
        filter(
          array(
            CASE
              WHEN bug_report THEN 'Bugs'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN pricing THEN 'Preços'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN game_balance THEN 'Balanceamento'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN toxicity THEN 'Toxicidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN community THEN 'Comunidade'
            END,
            CASE
              WHEN visuals THEN 'Visual'
            END
          ),
          x -> x IS NOT NULL
        )
      ) x
      AS t
),
tot AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(at) AS day,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM
    f
  GROUP BY
    DATE(at)
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    tipo_t,
    COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM
    ex
  GROUP BY
    day,
    tipo_t
)
SELECT
  c.day,
  c.tipo_t AS tema,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(c.c) OVER (
          PARTITION BY c.tipo_t
          ORDER BY c.day
          RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
      / NULLIF(
        SUM(t.n) OVER (ORDER BY c.day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
        0
      ),
    1
  ) AS share_7d
FROM
  cnt c
    JOIN tot t
      ON c.day = t.day
ORDER BY
  c.day,
  c.tipo_t

datasets.name: reader
queryLines:
SELECT
  at,
  game AS jogo,
  language AS idioma,
  score AS nota,
  sentiment AS sentimento,
  content AS comentario,
  bug_report,
  pricing,
  game_balance,
  toxicity,
  community,
  visuals
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          *,
          filter(
            array(
              CASE
                WHEN bug_report THEN 'Bugs'
              END,
              CASE
                WHEN pricing THEN 'Preços'
              END,
              CASE
                WHEN game_balance THEN 'Balanceamento'
              END,
              CASE
                WHEN toxicity THEN 'Toxicidade'
              END,
              CASE
                WHEN community THEN 'Comunidade'
              END,
              CASE
                WHEN visuals THEN 'Visual'
              END
            ),
            x -> x IS NOT NULL
          ) AS temas
        FROM
          reviews_enriched
        WHERE
          (
            :game = 'Todos'
            OR game = :game
          )
          AND (
            :language = 'Todos'
            OR language = :language
          )
          AND (
            :periodo.min IS NULL
            OR DATE(at) >= :periodo.min
          )
          AND (
            :periodo.max IS NULL
            OR DATE(at) <= :periodo.max
          )
      )
    WHERE
      (
        :tipo = 'Todos'
        OR array_contains(temas, :tipo)
      )
      AND (
        :sentimento = 'Todos'
        OR sentiment = :sentimento
      )
  ) f
WHERE
  content IS NOT NULL
  AND length(trim(content)) > 0

datasets.name: dim_sentimento
queryLines:
